title: Shallow Layer Condition Propagation (Redundant Boundary Validation)
pattern: Multiple shallow abstraction layers with identical signatures sequentially checking the same precondition boundary values.
why_bad: It creates design complexity and adds execution cost on hot paths by executing redundant branch conditional assembly instructions over and over.
detection: Call stacks composed of methods passing transient bounds parameters down while repetitively validating success states.
counterexample: Multi-process/process boundary checks where security sandboxing is required. `Context-dependent`.
fix: Design deeper classes with unified boundary validation at the entry points.
